description: German works council advisor: rights-check, decisions, deadlines, and BetrVG knowledge from betriebsrat.de

novel_features.name: Rights Check
novel_features.description: Answers 'Does the Betriebsrat have a say in this?' — maps situation to BetrVG paragraphs and co-determination type

novel_features.name: Decision Advisor
novel_features.description: Step-by-step decision support: classify situation, find applicable §§, determine BR rights, recommend action

novel_features.name: Deadline Calculator
novel_features.description: Calculates legal deadlines for BR response (§ 102 Anhörung: 1 week ordinary, 3 days extraordinary dismissal)

novel_features.name: Checklist Generator
novel_features.description: Generates step-by-step action checklist for BR in a given situation (Betriebsänderung, Massenentlassung, Kündigung)

novel_features.name: Meeting Prep
novel_features.description: Generates agenda, quorum rules, questions for employer for a BR meeting on a specific topic

novel_features.name: BetrVG Paragraph Lookup
novel_features.description: Plain-language explanation of any BetrVG paragraph with topic links and co-determination classification

novel_features.name: Co-determination Type Classifier
novel_features.description: Classifies BR rights as: Mitbestimmung (erzwingbar) / Mitwirkung / Unterrichtung / keine
